idea-plugin.name: Diff Line Stats
idea-plugin.description:
Show added and deleted line counts after each file label in the native Git diff tree, including Show Diff with Working Tree. Preload every file in the comparison in the background, including collapsed directories and off-screen rows.

Early preview for IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3. Binary, oversized and unavailable files show a status instead of counts.

在原生 Git 差异文件列表的文件标签后显示绿色 +新增、红色 −删除行数，打开列表即后台预加载所有文件。 使用列表实际比较的两个版本，后台计算，支持新增、删除、重命名和方向交换。 当前适配 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3；二进制、超大文件或读取失败会显示明确状态。
idea-plugin.change-notes: Support IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 (263.7307+), retaining trailing line counts and background preloading for every comparison file.
